info.name: Academic Profile AP1-AP5 Tests
info.description: Manual Postman checks for the shared academic profile facade, school/university academic profile providers, and AP4 excluded/incomplete explanation response fields. Uses only routes wired in src/app.js, src/routes/authRoutes.js, and src/routes/institutionRoutes.js.

request.description: Requires an existing verified user whose membership has the route/provider permissions needed for the target request. For staff target academic-profile route, admin currently needs membership.manage at the route layer plus class.manage or section.manage at provider layer.
Requires an existing verified student user. For self-profile requests, this user must have an active student membership in the target institution.
Optional sanity check for the admin token and institution context.

item.name: 05 AP4 Excluded Explanation Scenarios
item.description: These requests are data-dependent. Set the corresponding expect* environment flag to true only after preparing fixture data for that reason code.

request.description: General AP4 shape check: excluded[].reasonCode, excluded[].message, and optional ids.

exec: pm.test('section_not_closed present when fixture expects it', () => { if (pm.environment.get('expectSectionNotClosed') === 'true') pm.expect(codes).to.include('section_not_closed'); });

request.description: Prepare an enrollment in a non-closed section, then set expectSectionNotClosed=true.

exec: pm.test('assessment_not_published present when fixture expects it', () => { if (pm.environment.get('expectAssessmentNotPublished') === 'true') pm.expect(codes).to.include('assessment_not_published'); });

request.description: Prepare a closed section with draft/announced or no published assessments, then set expectAssessmentNotPublished=true.

exec: pm.test('missing_assessment_result present when fixture expects it', () => { if (pm.environment.get('expectMissingAssessmentResult') === 'true') pm.expect(codes).to.include('missing_assessment_result'); });

request.description: Prepare a closed section with published weight total 100 and at least one missing/null score, then set expectMissingAssessmentResult=true.

exec: pm.test('invalid_assessment_configuration present when fixture expects it', () => { if (pm.environment.get('expectInvalidAssessmentConfiguration') === 'true') pm.expect(codes).to.include('invalid_assessment_configuration'); });

request.description: Prepare a published assessment with invalid maxScore or weight, then set expectInvalidAssessmentConfiguration=true.

exec: pm.test('incomplete_assessment_weight_total present when fixture expects it', () => { if (pm.environment.get('expectIncompleteAssessmentWeightTotal') === 'true') pm.expect(codes).to.include('incomplete_assessment_weight_total'); });

request.description: Prepare published assessments whose weight total is not 100, then set expectIncompleteAssessmentWeightTotal=true.

exec: pm.test('invalid_credit_hours present when fixture expects it', () => { if (pm.environment.get('expectInvalidCreditHours') === 'true') pm.expect(codes).to.include('invalid_credit_hours'); });

request.description: Prepare an otherwise finalized university section whose subject has invalid creditHours, then set expectInvalidCreditHours=true.

exec: pm.test('missing_academic_policy present when fixture expects it', () => { if (pm.environment.get('expectMissingAcademicPolicy') === 'true') pm.expect(codes).to.include('missing_academic_policy'); });

request.description: Prepare a closed/published/finalized section in a semester with no resolvable university academic policy, then set expectMissingAcademicPolicy=true.

item.name: Cross-Tenant Or Wrong Institution Staff Access

exec: pm.test('cross-tenant staff access is blocked', () => pm.expect([400, 403, 404]).to.include(pm.response.code));

request.description: Uses a target student from the school tenant against another institution id. Expected 400/403/404 depending on the actor membership/data setup.

exec: pm.test('school institution did not return university profile', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().academicProfile.institutionType).to.eql('school'));
pm.test('university institution did not return school profile', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().academicProfile.institutionType).to.eql('university'));
